description:
§5 / §22 (S459 round 6, F2) — markup produced by a compile-time `^{ emit(...) }` is re-parsed by the same native attribute reader as a component body, so a single-quoted attribute value in it (`

`) is refused: E-META-EVAL-002 naming the underlying E-ATTR-001. Before S459 round 5 the reader shredded it into valueless attributes (`

`) at exit 0. A language-wide consequence of the round-5 L2 fix: `'` is not an attribute-string delimiter anywhere.
rationale: SPEC §5 (S111 quoted-text model): "The attribute quoted-string form is `"`-only (double-quote; single-quote is not an attribute-string delimiter)." Emitted meta markup is scrml markup and follows the same rule.
